jobs.name: Heilung
jobs.prompt: Generate a SINGLE isolated small game pickup SYMBOL on fully transparent background. This is a separate foreground layer that will be composited onto a shared grey tile later. DO NOT draw a tile, plate, grey patch, background, border frame or ground shadow. Main reference input is an old game icon; extract ONLY its colored symbol identity, ignore its square grey tile and old pixel staircase. Create crisp SMOOTH vector-like contours, professional clean miniature game icon, no artificial pixelation. Must survive reduction to 12x12 visible pixels in a 16x16 total icon. Use 3-4 large solid opaque color areas, strong silhouette, clean thin dark colored outline, bright saturated face. No texture, noise, dirty spots, airbrushed shadows, vague gradients, lighting bloom, reflections, realistic metal, blur, black cloud or ornamental detail. Keep all colored parts fully opaque; only empty space is transparent. Center one symbol with 12 percent transparent margin on every side. Square 1024x1024 canvas. No text, no sheet, no multiple icons. Subject: A symmetric upright red medical plus sign, equal thick arms. Deep burgundy outer contour, saturated crimson main face, a single brighter coral-red upper-left bevel strip. No gap or internal hole. Variant B: maximum small-size legibility, bold compact silhouette, slightly broader symbol strokes and extremely restrained crisp bevel; the colored main face must remain large and uniform.
